# Set Aside UK

> A free 2026/27 tax pot calculator for UK sole traders in England, Wales and Northern Ireland, plus a paid planning kit. This is an estimate, not tax advice, and not Making Tax Digital software. It is not affiliated with HMRC.

The working brand name is Set Aside UK, a proposed product of Fitz Butler-Smith, a UK sole trader. Figures were checked against GOV.UK on 14 November 2026 (Europe/London).

## What the free calculator does

- Estimates Income Tax and Class 4 National Insurance on trading profit for the tax year 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027.
- Applies the standard Personal Allowance of £12,570, withdrawn by £1 for every £2 of income above £100,000.
- Uses England, Wales and Northern Ireland rates: 20% up to £37,700 of taxable income, 40% from £37,701 to £125,140, 45% thereafter.
- Class 4 NI: 6% on profits over £12,570 up to £50,270, and 2% above £50,270.
- Shows payments on account, with dates: 31 January 2027, 31 July 2027, 31 January 2028 and 31 July 2028. For a first-year filer, the large payment is usually 31 January 2028 (the bill plus the first instalment towards the next year), not January 2027.

## What it does not do

- It does not file a tax return or send Making Tax Digital quarterly updates. A web calculator or spreadsheet is not, on its own, Making Tax Digital software.
- It does not calculate Scottish Income Tax, student loans, the High Income Child Benefit Charge, Marriage Allowance, savings or dividend tax, capital gains, or VAT payable.
- It does not tell a named person what they must pay.

## Official sources

- Income Tax rates: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/rates-and-allowances-income-tax/income-tax-rates-and-allowances-current-and-past
- Self-employed National Insurance: https://www.gov.uk/self-employed-national-insurance-rates
- Payments on account: https://www.gov.uk/understand-self-assessment-bill/payments-on-account
- HMRC estimator: https://www.gov.uk/self-assessment-tax-calculator
- VAT registration: https://www.gov.uk/register-for-vat
- Making Tax Digital software finder: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-software-that-works-with-making-tax-digital-for-income-tax

## Paid kit

The paid kit (£19, one-off) is live at https://payhip.com/b/CgFcz. It adds a rolling 12-month VAT threshold tracker against £90,000, income and expense logs, an invoice log, and quote, invoice and payment-chaser templates. Listing link: https://payhip.com/b/CgFcz

## Guides

Short explainers for 2026/27. Each one links to the calculator and to the £19 kit. They are estimates, not tax advice, and not Making Tax Digital software. Figures were checked against GOV.UK on 15 November 2026 (Europe/London).

- [How much to set aside for tax as a UK sole trader (2026/27)](guides/how-much-to-set-aside.html): Personal Allowance £12,570, England, Wales and Northern Ireland bands, and Class 4 at 6% then 2%. A £30,000 profit example is £4,531.80 of Income Tax and Class 4. A first-year 31 January 2028 figure in that example is £6,797.70 if payments on account apply.
- [Payments on account explained (first-year Self Assessment)](guides/payments-on-account.html): Two instalments, each half of last year’s tax, due by midnight on 31 January and 31 July. Not required if last year’s tax was under £1,000 or more than 80% was paid outside Self Assessment. HMRC’s published example is a £3,000 bill: £4,500 on 31 January and £1,500 on 31 July.
- [VAT registration threshold (£90,000 rolling 12 months)](guides/vat-registration-threshold.html): Register if taxable turnover goes over £90,000 in any 12 months, or is expected to in the next 30 days. This is turnover, not profit. The free calculator does not track it. The £19 kit includes a rolling tracker.
